summary: Tested /application page for 'Further Details' textarea feature and backend Airtable integration. Found and fixed a critical backend bug: field names in fields_dict didn't match the 'Membership Contact Inquiry Form (Softr)' Airtable table schema. After fixing field names, all 5 backend tests pass. Frontend UI correctly shows Further Details textarea with correct placeholder below Recommended By.

critical.issue: FIXED: fields_dict used wrong Airtable field names for 'Membership Contact Inquiry Form (Softr)' table causing UNKNOWN_FIELD_NAME 500 error. Fixed mappings: 'Work Email'→'Email (Work)', 'Position'→'Job Title', 'Personal Email'→'Email (Personal)', 'Network'→'Networks Interested In', removed non-existent 'Country' and 'Recommended By' fields

minor.issue: Country field is collected in the form but 'Country' does not exist as a field in the Airtable table 'Membership Contact Inquiry Form (Softr)'. Country data is silently dropped on submission. Main agent should either add Country field to Airtable table or remove it from the form.

Recommended By has no corresponding Airtable field in new table. Now combined with further_details into 'Message' field. Main agent should verify this is acceptable or add a dedicated 'Recommended By' field to the Airtable table.

integration_issues.issue: Could not complete full E2E form submission test via Playwright due to react-select Country/Network dropdowns not being interactable with standard Playwright selectors (no [class*='__dropdown-indicator'] or [class*='__option'] found when scrolled). Direct API tests confirm the backend integration works correctly.

action_items: Verify Country field: 'Country' doesn't exist in 'Membership Contact Inquiry Form (Softr)' Airtable table. Decide whether to add it to the table or remove from the form submission payload.

Verify 'Recommended By' handling: field doesn't exist in new Airtable table. Currently it is being combined into the 'Message' field. Add dedicated Airtable column or confirm combined approach is acceptable.
Manually test full form submission in browser to verify success state shows correctly (Playwright couldn't automate react-select dropdowns).
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Backend field names in submit_membership_application endpoint now match actual Airtable table 'Membership Contact Inquiry Form (Softr)'. Confirmed by querying Airtable API for actual field names.
Networks Interested In is a linked record field in Airtable. Passing array of strings with typecast=True works (confirmed by passing tests). Airtable resolves linked record IDs by name.
Further Details (further_details) correctly maps to 'Message' Airtable field. The mapping is working and field is in the correct location in UI.

success_rate.backend: 100% (5/5 tests pass after field name fix)
success_rate.frontend: 80% (UI elements verified, E2E submit blocked by Playwright react-select limitation)

seed_data_creation: 3 test records created in Airtable 'Membership Contact Inquiry Form (Softr)' during backend testing (test@example.com, testnodetails@example.com, modeltest@example.com)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend field names fixed in server.py submit_membership_application (lines 1487-1514). Confirmed Airtable table field names via API: Name, Email (Work), Phone Number, Company, Job Title, Networks Interested In (linked record), Source of Inquiry, Email (Personal), Message. 'Country' and 'Recommended By' fields do NOT exist in the table. Further Details textarea is at lines 577-591 in MembershipApplicationPage.js with id='further_details', placeholder='Add any additional details you'd like to share with us'. Form reset correctly clears further_details (line 205). react-select Country dropdown ID is react-select-3-input, Network is react-select-5-input.
rca_of_issues: Root Cause: Backend submit_membership_application endpoint (server.py ~line 1490) used field names from the OLD Airtable table (Work Email, Position, Personal Email, Network). The new table 'Membership Contact Inquiry Form (Softr)' has different field names: Email (Work), Job Title, Email (Personal), Networks Interested In. No 'Country' or 'Recommended By' fields exist in the new table. Airtable's UNKNOWN_FIELD_NAME error only reports the FIRST unknown field ('Work Email'), masking subsequent unknown fields. Fix: Updated all field name mappings in fields_dict to match the actual Airtable table schema verified by querying GET https://api.airtable.com/v0/appqyKMZnFfgSuJKt/Membership%20Contact%20Inquiry%20Form%20(Softr)?maxRecords=1.
